2610.12997.title: Benchmarking Embedding Geometries and Clustering Algorithms for Unsupervised Patent Claim Classification
2610.12997.paper_summary: Prior-art retrieval systems are structurally organized around classification codes, making cross-code discovery difficult. This paper asks if an unsupervised representation trained on patent text can recover relevant connections that code-restricted search cannot, and if hyperbolic space helps. We trained a hyperbolic and a matched Euclidean Variational Autoencoder (VAE) on 45,000 US patents (96 runs, 6 seeds). The hyperbolic model retrieves genuinely cross-category prior art 52% more often than the Euclidean model (18.76% vs. 12.34% of top-10 results, 3,000 queries). This represents a practical gain for the motivating search problem. The hyperbolic model agrees less with official classification (NMI 0.2392 vs. 0.3206), which we explain geometrically: the two measures capture different goals, and only one aligns with prior-art search needs. In a study of 10 technology domains (50,000 more patents), we find that a domain's classification breadth--the number of distinct CPC subgroups spanned--predicts approach performance (Pearson r=-0.642, p=0.045, N=10), and that patents per subgroup is an even stronger predictor (r=0.715, p=0.020). This provides a checkable signal for practitioners to determine where the method is most valuable. We report all findings with statistical transparency and release a complete, 91-test automated implementation.
2610.12997.paper_summary_zh: 先前的專利檢索系統在結構上圍繞著分類代碼組織，這使得跨代碼的發現變得困難。本文探討一個無監督的表示法是否能夠從專利文本中恢復出代碼限制搜索無法獲得的相關聯繫，以及雙曲空間是否有助於此。我們在45,000個美國專利（96次運行，6個隨機種子）上訓練了一個雙曲和一個匹配的歐幾里得變分自編碼器（VAE）。雙曲模型檢索到真正的跨類別先前技術的頻率比歐幾里得模型高52%（前10名結果中，雙曲模型為18.76%，歐幾里得模型為12.34%，共3,000個查詢）。這對於推動搜索問題來說代表了一個實際的增益。雙曲模型與官方分類的協調性較低（NMI 0.2392對0.3206），我們從幾何學的角度解釋這一點：這兩個度量捕捉了不同的目標，只有一個與先前技術搜索的需求對齊。在對10個技術領域（50,000個以上的專利）的研究中，我們發現一個領域的分類廣度——所涵蓋的不同CPC子組的數量——能預測方法的表現（Pearson r=-0.642，p=0.045，N=10），而每個子組的專利數量則是更強的預測因子（r=0.715，p=0.020）。這為實踐者提供了一個可檢查的信號，以確定該方法最具價值的地方。我們以統計透明度報告所有發現，並發布完整的91測試自動化實現。
